title: Fluffy Quinoa
description: Light, fluffy quinoa with separate grains: rinse, toast, simmer and rest. A reliable base for bowls, salads and sides.

steps.text: Rinse the quinoa in the sieve under running water, rubbing it between your fingers, for about {time 30 sec notimer}. This washes off its bitter coating. Drain well.
Heat the oil in the saucepan over medium heat. Add the quinoa and stir until dry and lightly toasted, {time 2-3 min}.
Add the water and salt and bring to a boil. Cover, turn the heat to low and simmer until the water is absorbed, {time 15 min}.
Take the pan off the heat and leave it covered for {time 5 min}. Fluff with a fork.

notes: Cooked quinoa keeps 5 days in the fridge and freezes well in bags.
